main_text.l: PROBLEMA I.

l.i: An ars liberalis recte distribuatur in contemplatricem

main_text.l: ARistoteles passim in suis libris, praesertim lib. 6. Me-
taph. c. 1. tria genera scientiarum, hoc est, discipli-
narum & artium constituit. Unum vocat
θεωρητικὸν[?], contemplativum: Alterum πρακτικὸν[?], actiuum: Tertium,
ποιητικὸν[?], effectiuum. Ratio illius distributionis sumitur par-
tim a subiecto doctrinali, partim a fine disciplinarum.
Alia enim versatur περὶ τὰ θεωρητὰ[?], hoc est, res so-
lummodo contemplandas: alia, περὶ τὰ πρακτὰ[?], hoc est,
res agendas; alia περὶ τὰ ποιητὰ[?], hoc est, circa res efficiendas: &
rursus alia solam cognitionem rerum circa quas versa-
tur sibi habet propositam; alia praeter cognitionem, et-
iam actionem; alia effectionem. Sed Zabar. lib. 1. de
nat. Log. c. 2. & alibi trimembrem illam distributionem Ari-
stotelis, ad bimembrem revocat. Itaque disciplinam aliam
dicit esse contemplatricem, aliam operatricem. Et hanc rur-sus vel πρακτικὴν[?] vel ποιητικὴν[?].
Caeterum hanc distributionem multis seculis in scho-
lis approbatam, quidam recentiores Philosophi in du-
bium vocant; & his argumentis impugnant. 1, Quia mem-
bra distributionis inter se non dissentiunt. Nulla enim
ars est, quae in sola rerum, quas tractat, cognitione acq-
uiescat, neque eam ad certum aliquem vitae humanae usu-
m transferat. Ideoque quaelibet ars simul est contem-
platrix & operatrix.
2, Quia vana esset omnis ars, cuius cognitio nullū[?] ha-

page.notes: Printed page number read as "19"; the glyph is slightly worn. Greek words with accents and breathings were read with uncertainty and are marked [?]; the Greek compound in item 46 is especially doubtful. The word "nullū" has a probable macron over the u, marked [?]. The initial "A" of the first paragraph is a large initial, joined to "Ristoteles". The paragraph beginning "2, Quia" carries on to the next page after "ha-". The line "Quia membra" is printed "Qu'a" with an apparent apostrophe, read as Quia.
